# Feedback Examples

弹层类组件通常使用 `open`/`update:open` 或 `open`/`onOpenChange`。

每个组件一节，供 MCP `tigercat_component` 按 `## {Component}` 抽取。绑定差异见 `shared/patterns/common.md`。

## Popconfirm

Runnable modules: `examples/example/vue3/src/examples/popconfirm/` and `examples/example/react/src/examples/popconfirm/`.

Note: 打开时焦点留在触发器，Tab 离开即关闭。确认返回的 Promise 在进行中时，Escape、点外面和再点触发器都关不掉；拒绝则留下。Vue 读返回值，不只看 `preventDefault`。

Vue: `<Popconfirm @confirm="onConfirm"><button>Delete</button></Popconfirm>`

React: `<Popconfirm onConfirm={onConfirm}><button>Delete</button></Popconfirm>`

Imports: use PascalCase subpaths such as `@expcat/tigercat-vue/Button` and `@expcat/tigercat-react/Button`. Hooks and `notification` use the same subpath rule. Shared types and helpers come from `@expcat/tigercat-core`.
